description: Geração por Usina em Base Horária is a dataset listed in Brazilian national electricity system operator open data portal (ONS), an open data portal, published or maintained by ONS. Geração verificada de usinas, conjuntos de usinas e grupos de pequenas usinas em base horária. Os Conjuntos são formados por usinas classificadas na modalidade Tipo II-C, conforme Submódulo 7.2 dos Procedimentos de Rede e são estabelecidos em Ajustamentos Operativos, disponíveis no MPO. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher ONS. Its tags are Geração, Histórico da Operação, Horário. It offers 241 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PARQUET, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Atribuição. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ons-portal.
